items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: And when he came to the office, I had breakfast with him one morning.

ctx.x: Yeah. So he took a hating to me. Because one guy, he called...the guy called him to get a date on an artist he had, and he told the guy... This is when I first found it out. He said he called him, and he said, "Call Walter Thomas; I ain't got nothin' for you." But he was that kind of guy. He was a Dutchman, and he hated me...

And when he came to the office, I had breakfast with him one morning. I said, "Man, it don't make sense that we got a hassle going on. Especially if we're going to work together." Because I was at the office before he got there; they'd just brought him in.
Well, it wasn't that you had lost these people. It was that your agency lost these people.
